headline: Steady tower growth, data centers lead, outlook raised
summary_short: Revenue rose 2.5% to $2,785M and AFFO per share grew 3.2% to $2.87, while net income per diluted share fell 9.9% to $1.64. Full-year property revenue outlook was raised by $55M at the midpoint.
summary_long: Property revenue grew 4.5% to $2,734M, helped by 16.3% cash revenue growth in Data Centers; organic tenant billings grew 1.1%. Net income fell on unrealized losses on equity investments and lower non-cash straight-line revenue. The company bought back $315M of stock and the board authorized another $2.0B. The distribution was $1.79 per share, up 5.3%. Management raised the property revenue midpoint, held Adjusted EBITDA, and lowered net income midpoints by $30M.
confidence_notes: Deltas are the release's own y/y growth rates. Net income and EBITDA growth are distorted by lower non-cash straight-line revenue and unrealized equity losses, as the release notes.

drivers.explanation: Data Centers cash revenue grew 16.3% and organic tenant billings grew 1.1%, partly offset by a decrease in non-cash straight-line revenue.
Unrealized losses on equity investments of about $71.5M versus gains a year ago, plus lower straight-line revenue.
Growth held back by a swing in net straight-line revenue to a loss of about $31.7M from a gain of $18.3M.
CEO cites consistent leasing demand across the tower portfolio and continued CoreSite outperformance, supporting a third outlook raise this year.
